definition: An authored intended hazard is absent, visually unlocatable, or materially cropped/occluded in the final controlling view.
minimum_detection: semantic-inventory overlay plus independent visual review at phone and print sizes
required_disposition: reject; repair scene; regenerate regions/descriptions; repeat all semantic QA

definition: An intended target can reasonably be interpreted as safe, as a different condition, or as requiring specialist/text/color knowledge not supplied by the scene.
minimum_detection: blind reviewer identifies condition from observable pixels and claim brief
required_disposition: reject or redesign; do not fix only by widening hotspot or explanation

definition: A non-target object/condition creates an additional plausible hazard not authored as target or decoy.
minimum_detection: independent negative-hazard sweep across slip/egress/chemical/electrical/sharp/material/sanitation/machine classes
required_disposition: reject; repair pixels/geometry and re-review whole scene

definition: An authored safe-but-suspicious decoy is actually unsafe or cannot be defended as safe exactly as depicted from source evidence.
minimum_detection: decoy rationale/source review plus independent visual review
required_disposition: reject decoy or change scene; never explain away unsafe art

definition: Object/body/fixture/contact geometry is mechanically or physically impossible in a way that affects recognition or safety meaning.
minimum_detection: geometry/pose review; compare source block and final cleanup
required_disposition: repair source geometry; re-render; invalidate prior hotspots

definition: Correctness depends on color, readable text, a tiny label, or another cue unavailable in grayscale/low-resolution/nonvisual use; or generation adds answer-bearing text/symbols.
minimum_detection: grayscale/print/phone review plus text/logo sweep
required_disposition: redesign using shape/placement/observable condition; reject generated pseudo-text

definition: Authored target/decoy region does not cover the final visible semantic condition or covers unrelated safe content.
minimum_detection: post-render region overlay review at canonical and phone sizes
required_disposition: regenerate/re-author region; create new scene interaction revision

definition: Tolerance-expanded regions allow one learner mark to map ambiguously to multiple target/decoy meanings.
minimum_detection: automated expanded-region intersection test plus visual review
required_disposition: separate scene targets or shrink/redesign regions; do not rely on arbitrary match order

definition: Distinct intended targets are too close/occluded for stable one-to-one marking and post-answer explanation.
minimum_detection: region separation metric plus blind marker exercise
required_disposition: recompose scene

definition: The scene already shows the intended control/correction applied so the target no longer represents the claimed unsafe condition.
minimum_detection: claim-vs-final-scene review
required_disposition: reject or change semantic condition; re-source if meaning changes

definition: Pre-commit visual, filename, SVG metadata/IDs, accessible text, DOM data, overlay, manifest exposure, or styling reveals target identity/count/correctness.
minimum_detection: pre-submit rendered DOM/accessibility/security audit plus asset-metadata scan
required_disposition: block publication; strip leak; retest cached/offline/print paths

definition: Visual annotation numbering, neutral/full descriptions, nonvisual equivalent, or print key use inconsistent/illogical zone order.
minimum_detection: cross-artifact ordered-ID comparison and screen-reader review
required_disposition: repair authored zone order and regenerate dependent artifacts

definition: Neutral pre-answer description names/interprets a hazard/decoy, implies correctness, or reveals target count.
minimum_detection: independent accessibility editor compares neutral text to semantic inventory without key
required_disposition: rewrite neutral text; retest all pre-commit surfaces

definition: Description states an object/condition not actually visible, omits a material observable fact available visually, or disagrees with final scene meaning.
minimum_detection: final-pixel-to-description audit
required_disposition: repair description or scene; if semantics change create new version

definition: Nonvisual task tests a different principle or leaks interpretation rather than presenting equivalent observable zone facts.
minimum_detection: concept-tag/source/zone comparison and screen-reader task review
required_disposition: rewrite equivalent; report visual/nonvisual results separately

definition: Target/decoy or decisive distinguishing detail is not readable/markable at supported small-phone layout even with provided zoom/pan controls.
minimum_detection: small-phone viewport test at documented zoom path
required_disposition: recompose or supply higher-resolution derivative; do not add answer cue

definition: Target/decoy or key annotation fails grayscale/low-ink print legibility or worksheet/key separation.
minimum_detection: grayscale print-preview and representative physical/PDF check
required_disposition: repair line weight/composition/derivative and re-review

definition: Any scene/component/input lacks project-owned or independently cleared provenance, or prohibited official/third-party art influenced the asset.
minimum_detection: rights ledger check against every source/component/model/input hash
required_disposition: reject until rights/provenance is resolved; substitution requires new review

definition: Accepted asset cannot identify all semantic/source/tool/component inputs and output hashes or deterministic route rebuild drifts without explanation.
minimum_detection: manifest completeness check; repeated build for deterministic routes
required_disposition: block promotion; pin inputs/tooling; preserve accepted output bytes

definition: Changed-scene variants repeat location/template cues strongly enough that position/camera/decoy pattern can substitute for concept recognition.
minimum_detection: family-level centroid/zone/camera distribution review and blind learner/editor check
required_disposition: recompose family or add structurally different variants

definition: Generated derivative adds/removes/duplicates/merges/splits a semantic object or changes target/decoy identity.
minimum_detection: control-vs-output instance inventory + independent review
required_disposition: reject derivative; do not repair through explanation

definition: Generated derivative violates silhouette/keypoint/contact/occlusion/depth rejection gates in GENERATIVE-BOUNDARY.md.
minimum_detection: automated structural comparison plus independent review
required_disposition: reject derivative; deterministic fallback remains available

definition: Depicted hazard/decoy/correction makes a substantive safety claim not supported by registered source lines for this item.
minimum_detection: claim registry/source-line review
required_disposition: remove/change claim or obtain adequate source; do not infer from image-generation priors

definition: Scene introduces high-level/specialist or otherwise unapproved content into an entry-level scored item.
minimum_detection: taxonomy/series compatibility validation
required_disposition: retire/reclassify scene or remove unsupported element
